shapeSummary: Round 32 mm diameter, 4 mm thick plate at the top (Y 4.5 to 8.5) with a 14 mm through bore and a 16 mm x 1 mm counterbore. It has four 3.3 mm tap-drill holes at 24 mm bolt-circle positions on the axes and four 4.5 mm round holes on the diagonals. Four 6 x 7 mm corner posts (X ±13 to ±19, Y 0 to 7) give a 38 mm width, and a 3.3 mm hole runs through each post along Z at y = 3.
warnings: Diagonal slotted holes are modeled as 4.5 mm round holes because the slot size is not dimensioned.
M4 holes are modeled as 3.3 mm plain holes with no threads.
Post shape is simplified to rectangular blocks, so the tapered gussets and fillets are omitted.
Post Y range of 0 to 7 and the plate offset are estimated from the side view.
Post hole diameter and depth are assumed. They are modeled as 3.3 mm and as passing through the post along Z.
The vendor's 43 mm width applies to two mounts, so the 38 mm single-part width was used.
cadquery:
post = cq.Workplane('XY').pushPoints([(sx*16, 3.5, sz*11.75) for sx in (-1,1) for sz in (-1,1)]).eachpoint(lambda l: cq.Workplane('XY').box(6, 7, 8.5).val().moved(l))
plate = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 8.5, 0)).circle(16).extrude(4)
body = plate.union(post)
bore = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 8.5, 0)).circle(7).extrude(4)
cb = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 8.5, 0)).circle(8).extrude(1)
holes1 = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 8.5, 0)).pushPoints([(0, 12), (0, -12), (12, 0), (-12, 0)]).circle(1.65).extrude(4)
holes2 = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 8.5, 0)).pushPoints([(8.5, 8.5), (-8.5, 8.5), (8.5, -8.5), (-8.5, -8.5)]).circle(2.25).extrude(4)
posthole = cq.Workplane('XY', origin=(0, 0, 0)).pushPoints([(-16, 3), (16, 3)]).circle(1.65).extrude(20, both=True)
part = body.cut(bore).cut(cb).cut(holes1).cut(holes2).cut(posthole)
